import re
from nltk import word_tokenize
from collections import Counter

def task_func(input_str):
    # Replace special characters, punctuation, and extra spaces with a single space
    cleaned_str = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", " ", input_str)
    
    # Tokenize into words
    words = word_tokenize(cleaned_str.lower())
    
    # Keep only alphanumeric tokens
    words = [word for word in words if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9]+", word)]
    
    # Count word frequency
    return dict(Counter(words))
